name: lagoon_keyframe
intent: The approved key frame (15 Nov, Blender) as a place in the open-world lagoon: a weathered head with a gate (focal point, upper left third), warm coral heads leading in from the near sand (table coral as the colour accent), the grown meadow framing the right edge, open sand and a clear blue lane for the fish school. Restrained, Japanese garden: three rock masses (focal arch, one behind, one far), five coral heads, one meadow bed, the rest is sand and water.
frame: key frame layout metres (Blender: x right, y forward, z up). godot = anchor_yaw * (x, z, -y) + anchor
source: papers/process/art_bible/style_level/keyframe/src/layout.json (scene.py cam slice) ported 1:1; upgrades are listed per item in 'why'; rocks from layout_arch_g.json (the arch as focal point, coordinator 21 Nov 05:16Z)
seat: every item is dropped onto the drawn ground under its own footprint (ray to the floor collision), as habitat.seat_blades did
